patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Reports the app as licensed and stops the native engine from verifying the licence, which unlocks the premium features.

patches.name: Unlock premium (native)
patches.description: Stops the native engine from verifying the licence, which is what the premium actions are gated on once the licence checks out in Java.
